Shanghai Municipal Council.
August 8th 1913
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE (DETECTIVE BRANCH)）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
Sir,
The Tuhun of Chkiang visited the Arsenal yesterday and had a long conversation with General Yang about the activities of the pro-Manchu party in Shanghai.
It is reported that Admiral Sah on behalf of the Central Government has agreed to reimburse the Navy for the money spent during its period of independence. The money will be paid through General Yang.
Rumours continue that undesirables in Frenchtown intend to plunder the City and extraordinary precautions are being continued.
The Military Governor has made a proposition to the effect that he will purchase all revolvers, pistols, rifles, and munitions of war from the revolutionaries at their full market value, and has offered to bear a share of the expense of sending all those who are without employment in Shanghai back to their native provinces. He has instructed the City Magistrate to confer with the Taoyin, the Chairman of the Chamber of Commerce in the Settlement and at Nantao with a view to ascertaining whether the balance of the money necessary can be raised and whether a workable scheme of repatriation which will cover all Shanghai can be formulated. He has asked for an answer within ten days.
He anticipates that he will be able to deal with the French Authorities through Lo Pau Hung, a Chinese Christian who is a member of the Consultative Committee of the French Municipal Council.
The Chinese Authorities as well as the leading merchants of the port are now thoroughly alive to the situation and they are agreed it must be dealt with at once if a repetition of the incidents which occurred at Hankow are to be avoided.
The Shooting affray at Siccawei on the night of August 5th wherein one Chinese Constable was shot and fatally wounded and a Police Inspector injured by a pistol bullet was caused by a number of armed men, who were on their way to attack the house of a wealthy Chinese who had been requested by letter to contribute to the support of revolutionaries and who had refused to do so.
Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
S.D.I.
Captain Superintendent of Police.
（左侧手写批注：Piz / Oct / 9/8）

上海工部局。
1913年8月8日
（印：上海工部局警务处（侦探股））
警务处，
（侦探股。）
先生：
浙江都督昨日访问了兵工厂，并与杨将军就亲满党在上海的活动进行了长谈。
据报，萨海军上将代表中央政府已同意偿还海军在独立期间所支出的款项。该笔款项将通过杨将军支付。
有关法租界内不良分子意图劫掠华界的谣言仍在流传，因此继续采取特别预防措施。
护军使提出一项提议，表示愿按十足市价向革命党人购买所有左轮手枪、手枪、步枪及军用弹药，并愿意承担部分费用，将上海所有失业人员遣送回原籍省份。他已指示上海县知事与道台、公共租界商会会长以及南市方面进行磋商，以确定能否筹得所需资金的余额，并制定一个涵盖整个上海地区的可行遣返方案。他要求在十日内给予答复。
他预计能够通过罗巴洪（Lo Pau Hung，音译）与法国当局打交道，此人为中国基督徒，系法国公董局咨询委员会委员。
中国当局以及本埠主要商贾现已充分认识到局势的严重性，他们一致认为，若要避免重演汉口发生的事件，必须立即着手处理此事。
8月5日晚在徐家汇发生的枪击事件中，一名华捕中弹受致命伤，一名巡官被手枪子弹击伤，该事件系由一群武装分子所为。这些武装分子当时正前去袭击一位富有的中国人的住宅，此人曾收到信件要求其捐款资助革命党人，但遭到拒绝。
您忠实的仆人，
（签名）
S.D.I.
警务处总监。
（左侧手写批注：Piz / Oct / 9/8）
